acceptance: Record a component-local, diagnostic-by-diagnostic evaluation of whether repository-local traces and bounded trace queries can replace Pi session JSONL for launch, model, tool, usage, delegation, handoff, outcome, and timing diagnostics.
Distinguish opaque trace/session correlation from exact-ID local session inspection and retain the rule that external sinks carry only opaque session IDs, never session content or store references.
Conclude whether replacement is currently supported without reading Pi session JSONL; do not perform a migration or expand tracer, launcher, evidence-tool, permissions, or external-backend behavior.

Validate the bounded evaluation with focused observability policy/content checks, task-record validation, JSON parsing, and diff/whitespace checks; preserve the selected backlog row and paired task artifacts until the completion handoff.
